display.purpose: Ceremony only: printed quotation/invoice titles and the thank-you line. Single Regular cut; never fake-bold, no CJK coverage.

headline.purpose: The hero title only; clamp-scaled system sans at weight 600.

body.purpose: System sans everywhere on screen; dimmed via white-opacity on dark, slate-600 on light.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked eyebrows (sky-300) and admin sidebar section labels.

shadows.name: card-glow
shadows.purpose: Hover response on public glass cards, paired with translateY(-6px) and border shift to rgba(124,192,255,0.5).

shadows.name: cta-glow
shadows.purpose: Resting glow under primary pill CTAs (shadow-lg shadow-blue-500/30).

shadows.name: paper-lift
shadows.purpose: Lifts the white A4 document off the dark quote page.

shadows.name: backstage-hint
shadows.purpose: Admin KPI card hover; the only shadow allowed backstage.

motion.name: ease-reveal
motion.purpose: Expo-out easing for fadeUp reveals (0.8s) with 0.08-0.38s stagger steps.

motion.name: float
motion.purpose: Gentle vertical drift on decorative accents.

motion.name: hover-lift
motion.purpose: Card and CTA lift on hover; -translate-y-0.5 buttons, -6px cards.

components.name: Primary Pill CTA
components.description: The signature public call-to-action: tenant spotlight color, lift and glow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--brand, #2f6fed); color: #fff; padding: 12px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1rem; box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(59,130,246,0.3), 0 4px 6px -4px rgba(59,130,246,0.3); transition: transform 0.2s ease, filter 0.2s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7cc0ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Pill
components.description: Secondary public action: translucent bordered pill with blur.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9); padding: 12px 24px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2); border-radius: 9999px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1rem; backdrop-filter: blur(8px); transition: transform 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7cc0ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Glass Card
components.description: The dominant public surface: translucent bordered card that glows on hover.
components.html:
Wedding Stage

Full backdrop, arch, and floral styling for your ceremony.
components.css: .ds-card-glass { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; color: #eef3ff; transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease, border-color 0.3s ease; } .ds-card-glass:hover { transform: translateY(-6px); box-shadow: 0 24px 50px -24px rgba(47,111,237,0.55); border-color: rgba(124,192,255,0.5); } .ds-card-glass h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-card-glass p { margin: 0; font-size: 0.9rem; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); line-height: 1.6; }

components.name: Admin Primary Button
components.description: Backstage primary action: compact, flat, accent-filled.
components.css: .ds-btn-admin { background: #2f6fed; color: #fff; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; transition: filter 0.2s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-admin:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-admin:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2f6fed; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Admin Input
components.description: Backstage form field: white, slate border, accent focus.
components.css: .ds-input-admin { background: #fff; color: #0f172a; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 0.875rem; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-input-admin:focus { border-color: #2f6fed; } .ds-input-admin::placeholder { color: #64748b; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Backstage tonal status pill (emerald=paid, blue=sent, amber=pending, red=lost).
components.css: .ds-badge-status { display: inline-block; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 8px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-badge-paid { background: #d1fae5; color: #047857; } .ds-badge-pending { background: #fef3c7; color: #b45309; }

components.name: Dark Input (Public)
components.description: Customer-facing field on the dark stage: translucent with brand focus.
components.css: .ds-input-dark { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); color: #eef3ff; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 12px; font-size: 1rem; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-input-dark:focus { border-color: var(--brand, #2f6fed); } .ds-input-dark::placeholder { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4); }

narrative.overview: The public sites feel like stepping into a beautifully lit event hall just before guests arrive: a deep evening-navy room washed with soft blue radial light, glass surfaces that catch a glow on touch, and a 3D centerpiece slowly turning under the lights. Each tenant company brings its own spotlight via --brand/--brand-2 CSS variables. Behind the ballroom is the backstage: a separate, deliberately unglamorous light system built for daily lead-to-invoice work. The third world is paper: quotations and invoices render as white A4 documents with a Roxborough CF serif title, presented like a lit sheet of paper on a stage table.
keyCharacteristics: Dark, cinematic customer surfaces; light, utilitarian staff surfaces; white printable documents.
One tenant spotlight color drives all action states via CSS variables.
Depth from light (glows) on the public site; depth from borders (flat) in admin.
Translucent white-opacity ladder instead of gray scales on dark.
Motion is staged: fade-up reveals with expo easing, floating accents, 3D hero; all honor prefers-reduced-motion.

rules.name: The Tenant Spotlight Rule
rules.body: Never hardcode Celebration Blue on a customer-facing surface. Actions use var(--brand), ambience uses color-mix. A company with a rose or gold brand must re-skin completely with zero code changes.

rules.name: The Two Rooms Rule
rules.body: The ballroom (dark public) and the backstage (light admin) never blend. A light slate input on a dark customer page is a defect, not a variation.

rules.name: The White Paper Rule
rules.body: Money documents always render as white paper: on screen inside rounded-xl shadow-2xl on the dark stage, in print as clean A4 with zero app chrome.

rules.name: The Letterhead Rule
rules.body: Roxborough CF is reserved for moments of ceremony. It never becomes a general heading font, and it has no bold cut, so never fake-bold it.

rules.name: The Shared Stack Rule
rules.body: EN, BM, and ZH all render in the system stack. Any future display-font use on customer surfaces must define an explicit CJK fallback before shipping.

rules.name: The Stage Light Rule
rules.body: Shadows on the public site are always tinted with the brand hue, never neutral gray. If an element needs neutral elevation, it should probably be white paper.

dos: Do route every customer-facing action color through var(--brand) / var(--brand-2).
Do keep public depth as brand-tinted glow and admin depth as slate-200 borders.
Do render money moments as white paper on the dark stage with shadow-2xl shadow-black/30.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion on every animation, including the R3F hero and reveal staggers.
Do dim text with the white-opacity ladder and verify ≥4.5:1 contrast for body sizes.
donts: Don't build generic AI/SaaS template surfaces: identical icon-card grids or hero-metric blocks; no NEW gradient-clipped text (the existing hero gradient is a documented brand exception, see The Signature Gradient Exception).
Don't drift toward cheap party-store: clip-art, balloon icons, loud primary color mixes.
Don't go corporate & sterile or cluttered directory: no stock-suit imagery, no dense ad-like listings.
Don't hardcode #2f6fed on customer surfaces; a rose-gold tenant must never leak blue.
Don't mix the rooms: no light slate controls on dark customer pages.
Don't use neutral gray shadows on the public site; tint with the brand hue or use borders.
Don't fake-bold Roxborough CF or use it on CJK text without a defined fallback.
